name: CFRE Omega - Chat Failure Resilience Engine
purpose: Detect chat/runtime failure signatures, preserve active mission state, diagnose likely dependency classes, and select a bounded recovery route without treating a failed response as mission completion.
mandatoryInvariants: A chat or transport failure is never a completion receipt.
Persist directive, objective, last proven state and next pending action before recovery.
Every replayable action has a stable resume token and idempotency key.
Read back the outcome of an uncertain external/tool write before retrying it.
Isolate a failed lane rather than freezing independent executable lanes.
Use only equivalent authorized alternate routes; authority is never inferred or inherited.
Respect an explicit user stop/cancel and preserve state for later resume.
A route-exhausted state is blocked, not complete.
Do not claim control of ChatGPT client transport, provider service state or browser/network repair without native evidence.

canDo: drive recovery when an authorized executor invokes it
cannotByItselfDo: restart or reauthenticate a browser session without an authorized client executor
guarantee a third-party provider is available
perform external effects merely because a recovery route is described
